authority.purpose: Portfolio-wide commercial packaging and money-path classification for FCR-governed work.
authority.truthBoundary: This contract defines commercial roles, hypotheses, metrics, and proof requirements. It does not prove customers, revenue, retention, provider state, checkout success, deployment, publication, or market demand.
authority.authorityBoundary: This contract grants no pricing, discount, spend, checkout, billing, publication, outreach, merge, deploy, provider, customer-data, or destructive authority.

publicPillars.rule: Supporting modules may compound Founder Control Room, but first-class standalone peers keep their own product identity and packaging unless an explicit bundle says otherwise.

Chief AI is a standalone Founder Intelligence product. It may be sold directly or included in an explicit bundle without collapsing product identity, runtime, authority, receipts, pricing truth, or evidence.

PromptOS is a standalone human-AI instruction governance product. Its public/free layer, direct paid paths, and explicit bundles are packaging choices and never collapse PromptOS into Founder Control Room.
SolContinuity is a standalone application-continuity and resilience product. It may exchange evidence with portfolio peers or participate in explicit bundles without becoming an FCR module.
StoryEngine is the creator-facing product; L99 is its execution, provenance, recovery, and evidence runtime.
Bip Jr belongs to the Se’kret Bip family world by default and does not become a separate commercial product without independent customer, payer, value, and repeat-payment proof.
Each commerce brand keeps its own catalog, customer economics, vendor, fulfillment, pricing, and checkout truth. Shared tooling does not collapse brand authority.

juss-beautiful-hair.value: Branded hair products delivered through a real commerce path.
juss-beautiful-hair.repeatEngine: Customer satisfaction and replenishment or next-style demand produce repeat purchases.
juss-beautiful-hair.nextMoneyTest: Prove the live product-to-cart-to-Shopify-checkout-to-paid-order path and measure unit economics from real orders.
juss-beautiful-hair.claimBoundary: Repository or browser proof is not paid-order or profitability proof.

founder-control-room.customer: AI-heavy solo founders, small product teams, and operators managing consequential multi-tool work
founder-control-room.payer: Founder, team, or organization owning the workspace
founder-control-room.value: One governed operating plane for intent, current truth, authority, action, evidence, outcomes, release control, and next gates.
founder-control-room.repeatEngine: The workspace becomes more valuable as decisions, evidence, approved workflows, outcomes, and operating continuity accumulate.
founder-control-room.nextMoneyTest: Get an external founder to complete an important job in FCR, return for another job, pay, and remain active through a defined retention window.
founder-control-room.claimBoundary: Builds, deployments, screenshots, internal founder use, and GitHub activity are product evidence but not external paid-retention proof.

storyengine.customer: Creators carrying an idea through creation, packaging, release preparation, distribution, commerce, and measurement
storyengine.payer: Creator, author, studio, or creative team
storyengine.value: Carry creative work from idea through a controlled release path without losing provenance, state integrity, or creator authority.
storyengine.repeatEngine: Creators return for additional projects, formats, release cycles, and measurement loops.
storyengine.nextMoneyTest: Prove one external creator can complete meaningful work to an approved release gate, pay, and return for another project or paid cycle.
storyengine.claimBoundary: Draft generation is not publishing, creator completion, payment, or repeat usage proof.

sekret-bip.customer: Teen user within a trusted family relationship
sekret-bip.payer: Parent, guardian, family, or later an approved institution
sekret-bip.value: Private emotional growth and self-expression with relationship-aware family boundaries rather than surveillance.
sekret-bip.repeatEngine: Ongoing reflection, companion use, growth history, and trusted family value create recurring utility.
sekret-bip.nextMoneyTest: Prove safe activation and retention first, then test a family willingness-to-pay offer without weakening teen privacy or trust.
sekret-bip.claimBoundary: Downloads, internal testing, or parent interest are not paid family retention proof.

think-tank.customer: Founder or builder with an idea that needs challenge and structure
think-tank.value: Turn a rough idea into a challenged, scored, versioned, portable Idea Record.
think-tank.repeatEngine: Idea evolution and pivots create repeat analysis while the strongest path graduates into ongoing FCR work.
think-tank.nextMoneyTest: Use the deterministic V0 as an entry experience and test whether a completed external Idea Record converts into a paid analysis or FCR workspace.
think-tank.claimBoundary: Local deterministic completion is not provider-backed AI, public deployment, billing, demand, or conversion proof.

chief-ai-machine.customer: Founder or team needing portable company intelligence, structured executive reasoning, and provider-independent continuity
chief-ai-machine.payer: Founder, team, organization, or deployment owner purchasing Chief directly or through an explicit bundle
chief-ai-machine.value: Preserve and synthesize company intelligence, compose capabilities, and support consequential reasoning while remaining provider-neutral and independently useful.
chief-ai-machine.repeatEngine: Company intelligence compounds as approved assets, decisions, evidence, outcomes, benchmarks, and provider comparisons accumulate.
chief-ai-machine.bundleRule: Chief may participate in an explicit multi-product bundle without becoming a module or subordinate product.
chief-ai-machine.separateOfferGate: Chief does not require FCR demand proof to exist as a separate offer; economic claims still require product-specific evidence.
chief-ai-machine.nextMoneyTest: Prove an external user can complete an important Chief-native job, return for another job, enter a paid path, and retain value over a defined window.
chief-ai-machine.claimBoundary: Standalone product identity, repository separation, and successful tests do not prove deployment, product-market fit, revenue, retention, or paid demand.

promptos.customer: Founders, builders, and teams needing reusable governed AI instructions and workflows across providers
promptos.payer: Founder, team, organization, or deployment owner purchasing PromptOS directly or through an explicit bundle
promptos.value: Turn reusable intent, context, prompts, skills, and workflow patterns into portable governed operating assets with lineage and evidence.
promptos.repeatEngine: Successful workflows and approved instruction assets compound into reusable operating leverage across future work.
promptos.bundleRule: PromptOS may participate in an explicit multi-product bundle without becoming a module or subordinate product.
promptos.separateOfferGate: PromptOS does not require FCR demand proof to exist as a separate offer; economic claims still require PromptOS-specific evidence.
promptos.nextMoneyTest: Prove an external user completes an important PromptOS-native workflow job, returns to reuse or create another governed workflow, and enters or commits to a paid PromptOS path.
promptos.claimBoundary: Prompt usage, prompt count, catalog size, repository separation, internal use, or browser proof do not prove revenue, retention, or paid demand.

solcontinuity.customer: Developers and teams operating applications across multiple infrastructure providers or recovery paths
solcontinuity.payer: Developer, team, organization, or deployment owner purchasing SolContinuity directly or through an explicit bundle
solcontinuity.value: Detect route disagreement and provider dependence, preserve continuity evidence, and support failover and recovery without silently trusting one infrastructure path.
solcontinuity.repeatEngine: Continuity manifests, evidence history, route coverage, and recovery knowledge compound as applications and provider paths evolve.
solcontinuity.bundleRule: SolContinuity may participate in an explicit multi-product bundle without becoming an FCR module or subordinate product.
solcontinuity.separateOfferGate: SolContinuity does not require FCR demand proof to exist as a separate offer; economic claims still require SolContinuity-specific evidence.
solcontinuity.nextMoneyTest: Prove an external developer or team integrates SolContinuity for a real continuity job, returns to operate or extend that coverage, and pays or commits to a paid pilot, license, or deployment path.
solcontinuity.claimBoundary: Package installability, self-host verification, Devnet evidence, tests, or repository independence do not prove adoption, revenue, retention, or paid demand.

truth-weaver.customer: FCR founder or team making evidence-sensitive decisions
truth-weaver.value: Separate evidence from inference, attack competing hypotheses, and turn survivors into smallest reversible tests.
truth-weaver.repeatEngine: Repeated high-consequence decisions create recurring decision-lab value.
truth-weaver.nextMoneyTest: Test whether the decision lab raises FCR activation, retention, or paid upgrade intent on real founder decisions.
truth-weaver.claimBoundary: Decision quality must be evidenced by downstream outcomes; a sophisticated reasoning trace is not a business outcome.

sweats.value: SWEATS apparel products once real approved catalog and fulfillment facts exist.
sweats.repeatEngine: Product satisfaction and future drops may produce repeat purchases once proven.
sweats.nextMoneyTest: Establish real Shopify catalog facts and prove product-to-cart-to-checkout before spending growth effort.
sweats.claimBoundary: Preview UI is not catalog, inventory, price, checkout, order, or revenue proof.

sleepwealth-agent.value: Governed consequential-agent architecture and paper/simulation research.
sleepwealth-agent.nextMoneyTest: Do not force monetization yet; extract proven governance primitives into FCR/Chief and require independent demand before creating a paid offer.
sleepwealth-agent.claimBoundary: Paper simulation, provider observation, and governance correctness are not demonstrated alpha or live-money revenue.

contentTeardownContract.purpose: Turn product/business analysis into truthful educational content without confusing attention with economics.
contentTeardownContract.rule: A content hook may simplify language, but the underlying teardown must preserve the current truth status of every economic claim.
